# FabGuard

> Professional home services across India — plumbing, electrical, carpentry, laundry, cleaning, and AC. Same-day visits, verified experts, cash on delivery.

FabGuard is a doorstep home-services brand operating pan-India. Customers browse services, add them to cart, and place cash-on-delivery orders. A membership program offers recurring discounts.

## Pages
- [Home](/): Service catalog, membership plans, testimonials, contact.
- [Orders](/orders): Customer order history (authenticated).
- [Terms and Conditions](/terms-and-conditions): Legal terms.
